title: Creekside Guesthouse Baker Hollow Farm-Nashville
description:
On our 40 acre farm just north of Nashville, you'll find plenty of space to spread out, hiking trails, horses, cows, chickens, and even a pig named "Wilma". Approximately 15miles to downtown Nashville, you will never be far from all the excitement that Nashville has to offer. Stay in and relax, take in the beauty of the grounds, or get out and party!
Pricing is for 4 guests. Please update the  number of guests and their ages. A fee will be calculated for the appropriate amount.

The space
Our property is gated and and has multiple creeks, ponds, and even a small waterfall from a cave entrance. You will find the main house a comfortable .2 miles away from the guest house. The residence is located on a 2nd level with interior garage available for parking. The first level contains a second residence that is occupied during the spring and summer months by my in-laws who are very kind and can also help or answer any questions that may arise.

Guest access
You will be given a gate code for entry to the property as well as garage door code for entry to the upper level.
Our farm is secured with a gated entry and exterior cameras. Please do not give out access codes to  delivery drivers, etc. 
Any visitors must be approved prior to entry of the property.

Other things to note
Our farm animals love attention and are hand fed most days. They are, however, stronger than they look and mommas with babies can be very protective so keep that in mind!
